$comment: Pinned upstream sources. scripts/vendor-core.sh and the Dockerfile resolve these exact revisions so the release is reproducible.

wordpress_core.notes: Official core mirror (SVN -> git, auto-updated). PHP 8.1+ required.

quran_text.notes: Uthmani text, 6236 verses with page/juz numbers. Transformed at build time into site/wp-content/plugins/baaboul-houda-core/data/quran.json by build/quran/build.mjs. Text is public domain (Tanzil/QCF); FR translations are fetched at runtime from alquran.cloud (CC-BY 4.0) and cached client-side.

js_dependencies.notes: All JS is bundled into site/wp-content/themes/baaboul-houda/assets/dist at build time. No CDNs required at runtime except Google Fonts and the live-stream providers (YouTube/Facebook).
